name: Lavender Shea Body Butter
blurb: Deep Shea Rest, whipped thick with raw African shea and a lavender-forward blend underneath. Massage it into damp skin after your shower and let it work on cracked heels and winter-dry patches while you sleep. Built as a night ritual, not just a lotion.

usageGuide.howToApply: Scoop a generous amount and massage directly into towel-damp skin immediately after bathing or showering to lock in deep hydration.
usageGuide.storage: Store at room temperature (below 80°F/27°C) to prevent melting. Shelf life is 6–12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Test a small amount on inner forearm before first use. Discontinue if irritation develops.
